interactions.name: Primary input
interactions.trigger: Pointer activation of the demonstrated primary control
interactions.response: The product advances from the entry surface into the task
interactions.cancellation: Move away without activating the control
interactions.failure: No activation leaves the entry state unchanged
interactions.recovery: Return to the visible control and activate it

interactions.name: Focus and selection
interactions.trigger: Select the demonstrated item, field, or workspace target
interactions.response: The target becomes the active context
interactions.feedback: Selection styling or an active detail surface is visible
interactions.failure: An unselected target does not advance the workflow

interactions.name: Navigation
interactions.response: The central product surface changes while application context remains
interactions.feedback: Destination content replaces the prior surface
interactions.failure: A wrong destination shows content unrelated to the goal
interactions.recovery: Navigate back to the demonstrated destination

interactions.name: Configuration
interactions.trigger: Enter or choose the demonstrated task parameters
interactions.response: The product reflects the configured values
interactions.feedback: The in-progress state exposes the chosen configuration
interactions.cancellation: Remove or replace the current choice
interactions.failure: An incomplete configuration cannot produce the shown result

interactions.name: Confirmation
interactions.trigger: Activate the demonstrated commit, create, run, send, or save action
interactions.feedback: The surface transitions toward the result
interactions.cancellation: Back out before the commit action
interactions.failure: Committing with the task incomplete leaves a no-result state
interactions.recovery: Complete the required context and confirm again

interactions.name: Backtracking
interactions.trigger: Return from the current detail or configuration surface
interactions.response: The previous product context is restored
interactions.failure: Leaving too early abandons the pending result
interactions.recovery: Re-enter the demonstrated task from the restored context

interactions.name: System feedback
interactions.trigger: Wait after the demonstrated committed action
interactions.response: The first meaningful result becomes visible
interactions.feedback: Result content replaces or augments the in-progress state
interactions.cancellation: No cancellation is shown after completion
interactions.failure: Stopping before feedback provides no completion evidence
interactions.recovery: Wait for the visible result state

interactions.name: Failure and recovery
interactions.trigger: Attempt to proceed without the demonstrated selection or context
interactions.response: The workflow remains incomplete rather than reaching the result
interactions.feedback: The expected result state is absent
interactions.cancellation: Return to the preceding stable surface
interactions.recovery: Restore the demonstrated context and repeat the confirmed action

motion_analysis.trigger: Nothing the viewer does: the clip is an official screen recording narrated by a presenter who stays in a round webcam bubble at the lower right. Inside it, a pointer hovers the sidebar's Add task control until an "Add task" tooltip appears at ~30s and clicks it, and text then types itself into the task field one character at a time — "send quote by eod today" over 42.0-45.4s and "call mom every other day at 9am" over 49.7-52.8s.
motion_analysis.start_state: Full-frame webcam shot of the presenter talking, with no product surface visible (0-11.5s).
motion_analysis.end_state: The Todoist macOS Inbox for the account "Denise" holding four tasks — Record videos (Today 5 PM), Focus time! (Yesterday 9-11 AM in red), send quote by eod (Today), call mom (Sunday 9 AM with a recurrence glyph) — held unchanged to the last frame (84-90.0s).
motion_analysis.continuity: One 90.033s render of 2698 frames (~29.97 fps). Motion inside a scene is continuous — characters appear one at a time in the task field, the date chip fills itself in while the words are still being typed ("Today" by 44s, "Sunday 9 AM" by 52s), the "Task added to Inbox" toast slides up at 46.0s and is still on screen at 60.6s — and scenes are joined by hard cuts: webcam to the cream agenda card at ~11.8s, agenda card back to webcam at ~16.8s, Inbox to the mint Clarify card at ~75.1s and back to the Inbox at ~77.3s. No still-image interpolation.
motion_analysis.feedback: Every action draws a visible answer in the same frame: the hovered sidebar control raises an "Add task" tooltip at ~30s; typed prose is parsed into a chip while typing continues, so "...by eod today" produces a green "Today ×" chip at 44-45s and "...every other day at 9am" produces a "Sunday 9 AM ×" chip at ~52s; activating the red Add task button both inserts the new row into the Inbox list and raises a "Task added to Inbox" toast carrying an Open link, at 46.0s and again at 54.2s.

observations: Every sidebar destination carries a text label beside its icon — Add task, Search, Inbox, Today, Upcoming, Filters & Labels, More — and the current destination is marked both by a pink row highlight and by pink label text, so selection is not carried by position alone (media/motion.mp4 at 88s).

Each task's due date is written out as words and numerals under the title rather than signalled by motion: "Today 5 PM", "Yesterday 9-11 AM", "Today", "Sunday 9 AM" (media/motion.mp4 at 88s). The overdue item is additionally red, so the colour is redundant with the word "Yesterday".

The add-task dialog names all of its controls in text — Today, Deadline, Priority, Inbox, Cancel, Add task — so the date the parser applied reads as the word "Today" in the chip and not only as a calendar glyph (media/state-02-progress.jpg, 45.017s).

In media/state-01-entry.jpg the agenda-card crop (x 195-360, y 95-200) measures a 17.03:1 luminance contrast ratio between its brightest 2% of pixels (255,255,230) and its darkest 2% (33,26,7); the dialog-title crop of media/state-02-progress.jpg (x 170-300, y 78-95) measures 8.11:1 for (81,79,82) against (255,255,255). Both computed with the WCAG relative-luminance formula over the retained JPEGs.

Committed state stays legible with the animation stopped: the toast text "Task added to Inbox" and its Open link remain on screen from 46.0s to about 60.6s, and every task title and date in the closing Inbox is text.
unknowns: Screen-reader names, roles, and live-region announcements were not exposed by the static-source recording.
Complete keyboard traversal and focus order were not established by the recording.
Reduced-motion preference handling and a nonanimated equivalent were not demonstrated.

evidence_gaps: accessibility never measured against the product
